title: A responsive card grid that respects reduced motion

concepts.description: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...)) lets a grid choose its own column count from the space available, with no media query per breakpoint.
concepts.context: the .cards rule in cards.css uses auto-fill with minmax so columns appear as the width allows

concepts.description: Wrapping the track minimum in min(100%, size) stops a fixed minimum from overflowing a container narrower than that size.
concepts.context: min(100%, 16rem) keeps one card from overflowing on a phone narrower than 16rem

concepts.description: A media query exposing the user's operating-system setting to reduce motion, which animation should honour.
concepts.context: the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block in cards.css removes the hover transform and transition
